$comment: Extension-owned 'what can I make' catalog (openspec add-surface-picker). Entries are catalog directory ids; each expands to every non-stub skill, design template and example with that id. Only 'ready' surfaces are shown. check-content-sync.mjs fails on missing or stub entries and unknown prompts. Goals (openspec desktop-first-run-welcome) route a plain-language aim to ready surfaces, in order; the same check fails on a goal naming an unknown or planned surface.

surfaces.label: Prototype
surfaces.description: A web page or app screen: landing page, pricing, waitlist, dashboard.
questions: What is the page for, and who is it for?
Any brand or visual style to follow?

surfaces.label: Mobile app
surfaces.description: Phone screens in device frames: an app's main screens or its onboarding.
questions: What does the app do, and which screens matter most?
Should it look like a particular app (Spotify, Monzo, Strava…)?

surfaces.label: Slides
surfaces.description: A presentation deck, from a brief or from a document you already have.
questions: What's the talk about, and for which audience?
Is there a document or data to build it from?

surfaces.label: Document
surfaces.description: A designed document to read in a browser: RFC, ADR, postmortem, PR explainer, spec, runbook, report, memo.
questions: What kind of document, and is there source material to start from?

surfaces.label: Wireframe
surfaces.description: Low-fidelity layouts to agree on structure before visual design.
questions: Which screens or flow, and hand-drawn or grey-box?

surfaces.label: Animation
surfaces.description: Motion frames and short animated pieces: title cards, logo reveals, animated charts.
questions: What should it show, and how long should it run?

surfaces.label: Résumé
surfaces.description: A one-page résumé, ready to print or export as PDF.
questions: Paste or point to your experience, and the role you're applying for.

surfaces.label: Research
surfaces.description: Turn interviews, notes or posts into an evidence-backed synthesis board.
questions: Where are the notes, transcripts or data, and what decision should this inform?

surfaces.label: Data report
surfaces.description: Charts and KPIs from a CSV or spreadsheet: reports, dashboards, finance summaries.
questions: Which data file, and what question should the report answer?

surfaces.label: Poster / flier
surfaces.description: A poster or flier for print or screens, in any size, with real QR codes.
questions: What is it for, and is it for print (which size) or screens?

surfaces.label: Social post
surfaces.description: Images sized for X, Instagram, LinkedIn, Xiaohongshu or a YouTube thumbnail.
questions: What's the post about, and which platform is it for?

surfaces.label: Campaign
surfaces.description: One message across every channel: social sizes, banners, display ads, landing page and email, in every language.
questions: What is the campaign for, and which channels does it need?
Which languages or audiences?

surfaces.label: HTML email
surfaces.description: A newsletter or launch email that renders in Gmail, Outlook and Apple Mail.
questions: What's the email announcing, and to whom?

surfaces.label: Diagram
surfaces.description: Architecture, flow, schema, state or sequence diagrams drawn from your code.
questions: What should the diagram explain, and which part of the code is it about?

surfaces.label: Color + type
surfaces.description: Compare color and type pairings side by side, then keep one as your design system.
questions: What's the brand, and how should it feel?

surfaces.label: 3D object
surfaces.description: A product or object in 3D, from a brief or your own model, as stills or a turntable.
questions: What object, and do you have a .glb model or an SVG logo of it?
Where will it go: a hero still, a transparent cut-out, or a turntable video?

surfaces.label: 3D scene
surfaces.description: A small 3D world: a diorama, room, courtyard or tabletop with a real sky and free CC0 textures and models, as stills or a flythrough video.
questions: What's the setting, and what must be in it?
A still, a flythrough video, or both? Does it need to match a real place or photo?

surfaces.label: Online shop
surfaces.description: Product images, a store banner, parcel cards and launch posts for a Shopify, Big Cartel or Etsy shop.
questions: What do you sell, and where (Shopify, Big Cartel, Etsy, other)?
Do you have a product list and photos?

surfaces.label: Game cards
surfaces.description: Card fronts, a back and a proof sheet from your card list and art, ready for a print house.
questions: Which game or card size, and which print house?
Do you have the card list and art?

goals.label: Promote an event
goals.description: A flyer, posts and a campaign for a meetup, sale, gig or open day.

goals.label: Sell or run a small shop
goals.description: Menus, posters, posts and a newsletter for a café, market stall or shop counter.

goals.label: Sell online
goals.description: Product images, a banner, posts and emails for your online shop, from your product list and photos.

goals.label: Make cards to print and sell
goals.description: A card set for your game, ready for the print house, and posts to show it off.

goals.label: Show an idea
goals.description: A landing page, phone screens or a short pitch to show people what you're building.

goals.label: Get hired
goals.description: A résumé, a one-page portfolio and posts about your work.

goals.label: Explain something
goals.description: Slides, a one-pager, a diagram or a report that makes a topic clear.

goals.label: Post regularly
goals.description: Social posts and thumbnails in the same style every week.

goals.label: Build a product screen
goals.description: Prototypes, wireframes and app screens for a product team.
